text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
The show that thoroughly analyzes a star's 
star power! "Star's Parameter Check~!"

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
The star we're investigating today is 
right here! This bright-shining runner 
currently lighting up the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to first-rate star 
Umamusume, it's none other than me!! King 
Halo!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The reason King is King... I'll make sure 
your eyes see every last bit of it!

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! The King style in full blast right 
from the start! This certainly raises my 
expectations~.

text_block_list.name: Show Staff
text_block_list.text:
And this time, the challenge is in her 
actual racing silk. I've heard it's a very 
special outfit.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course... but if you are to prove 
you are first-rate, a racing outfit is the 
proper formal attire, is it not?

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
I see... Then, through various tests, let 
us thoroughly dissect your star power, 
which shines as brilliantly as that 
outfit!

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
The first parameter check is 
'Conversational Ability'! This time, 
you'll be talking to the judges about your 
Racing Racewear. However—

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
"—You will be doing this in 'English'! How 
will you communicate in an unfamiliar 
language? ...Let's do a parameter check!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"The jewel in the waist ornament is"... 
Um, "designed with an emerald in mind."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Being done to" is... I think I read about 
this in a book before— ...Ah, that's it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"By wearing an emerald, which is said to 
be the 'intellectual eye that sees into 
the future'..."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I foresee my own future, continuing to 
stand tall as a first-class Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: English Proficiency Judge
text_block_list.text:
"Wow! What wonderful knowledge and spirit! 
Above all, the way you look straight into 
your opponent's eyes— There's no doubt 
about it, you're a star!"

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text: Next parameter check is... 'Performance'!

text_block_list.name: Performance Judge
text_block_list.text:
—Traditional Japanese dance... It is truly 
beautiful. However, why that...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Dance is spatial art. Hence... the 
dignified beauty of a fluttering hem. The 
nobility of occasional emerald green 
sparkles."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Because with every ounce of charm King 
embodies, she can captivate the audience's 
eyes.

"...And while King Halo had made smooth 
progress up to this point—"

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
—Aaaand King Halo by a hair! She dodges 
the ball by a hair!

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
However, they are struggling immensely 
with the final parameter check: 
"Adaptability"!

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
Reach the goal while keeping the paper 
lantern lit. King Halo has somehow made it 
through after enduring countless 
obstacles, but——

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What is this, a quagmire?! And there's 
barely any footing...

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, what awaits is the dreaded 
"Quagmire Zone." The tension of knowing a 
fall spells doom forces the participants 
to display true "adaptability"—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, you. This is fine as long as 'the 
flame doesn't go out,' right?

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
? Yes! As long as it gets me across the 
finish line.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: If so—then...
(Plop!)

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
!? S-Say it isn't so! King Halo has fallen 
into the mire...

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
N-No! She dismounted of her own accord and 
is moving forward! It's legal under the 
rules, but her pure white outfit is—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —These clothes are...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
This outfit is formal attire to prove that 
I am "first-class."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: And being truly top-notch means...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"If it's for the sake of victory, I'm not 
afraid to get covered in mud!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, a little smudge like 
this is nothing more than dust before 
King's radiance.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now, watch closely until the very end! —I 
shall teach you what it truly means to be 
first-class!

The recording safely concluded, and King 
Halo returned, covered in mud.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufun. Who do you think I am? Something 
like this is nothing—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Achoo! ...I'm not!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
King has been cool since the very moment 
of her birth. Isn't that obvious?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If you're going to praise me, do it 
properly, with lots and lots of detail♪
